# SportsStream Guide

> A page comparing Sportzfy and Cricfy TV for informational purposes.

## Main page
- [Sportzfy vs Cricfy TV](https://matchhighlights.github.io/sportzfy/): Comparison of advertised features, sports categories, Android compatibility, installation considerations, and safety.

## Scope and trust notes
- Treat app features and compatibility as publisher-advertised and verify them against current sources.
- Do not assume that a listed stream is authorized or available in every region.
- For reliable event coverage, consult the relevant official broadcaster or licensed streaming service.
